_note: Every default of the Scale simulator (t-sim). kind: published (read from a source), derived (formula from published inputs), fitted (set so one published figure is reproduced, by construction), illustrative (a stated assumption). Fetched 2026-10-04 unless a date is given. The JS (parts/31_js_sim_model.js) embeds the same values; src/sim/check_js.mjs confirms they are equal.

msgs_per_user_day.note: chat messages per daily active user per day

api_per_msg.note: other API calls per message (load history, list chats, auth refresh, settings)

peak_factor.note: busiest hour rate / daily average rate (default; adjustable on the tab, same 2x as the Reading's step 6); everything except the queue is sized for the peak

writes_per_msg.note: save user message, save reply, update conversation

jobs_per_msg.note: e.g. moderation check and search indexing after each message

isl.note: input tokens per model call (prompt plus history); also the TensorRT-LLM table's ISL

app.price_note: AWS on-demand Linux, us-east-1, read through Vantage's mirror of the AWS price list on 2026-10-04 (the same entry as the Numbers tab, src/num/num_data.json)

cpu_per_req_s.note: 5 ms of CPU per API request: 4 vCPU gives 800 requests/s per server

enqueue_cpu_s.note: cost to put one job on the queue

lb.note: Application Load Balancer, us-east-1; LCUs estimated as one new connection per request (upper bound, keep-alive lowers it)

db.price_note: large $0.239/h, 2xlarge $0.956/h, 16xlarge $7.65/h: exactly linear at $0.1195 per vCPU-hour; xlarge, 4xlarge, 8xlarge derived from that

write_cpu_s.note: insert or update with index maintenance and write-ahead log

replica_apply_cpu_s.note: a replica replays each write from the log

rows_per_user.note: stored messages per user, the table a missing index forces you to scan

scan_rows_per_s.note: rows a sequential scan reads per second per core

ops_per_s.note: redis.io benchmark examples without pipelining: 72,145 to 188,324 requests/s on one instance; Redis executes commands on one thread

queue.note: SQS standard Tier1 $0.40 per million requests (price list published 2026-09-11); 1M free per month (https://aws.amazon.com/sqs/pricing/); send, receive, delete = 3 calls per job

workers.note: one job at a time per vCPU

gpu.model: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct, FP8 weights and FP8 KV cache (nvidia/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-FP8)

published_tps_per_gpu.note: TensorRT-LLM perf overview, H100 TP2 FP8, ISL/OSL 1000/1000, maximum-load throughput, output tokens/s per GPU

price_gpu_h.note: Lambda on-demand H100 SXM, 8-GPU instance, per GPU-hour

gpu.hw_note: datasheet: 80GB, 3.35TB/s, FP8 3,958 TFLOPS with sparsity, so 1,979 dense
gpu.params_note: Llama 3.3 70B parameter count from its config (80 layers, d 8192, FFN 28672, 64 heads, 8 KV heads, vocab 128256, untied)

prefill_mfu.note: share of dense FP8 peak reached during prefill

batch.note: max concurrent streams per replica (the engine's batch limit)
